data.name: Ornavision AR Engine
data.description: Developed a real-time AR engine for virtual jewelry try-on using computer vision and facial landmark tracking. Focused on performance optimization, modular architecture, and realistic rendering.

data.name: Blockchain-Based Decentralized Voting System
data.description: Built a decentralized voting system using Ethereum, Truffle, Ganache, and MetaMask. Implemented secure voter authentication with tamper-resistant blockchain storage.

data.name: Resume Analyzer using NLP
data.description: Developed an NLP-based application that extracts, analyzes, and scores resumes based on skills and job relevance. Implemented semantic matching and automated candidate evaluation.

data.name: Fake Pop-up Detection System
data.description: Created a desktop application using Python, TensorFlow/Keras, OpenCV, and Tkinter. Detects malicious pop-ups and fraudulent QR codes with approximately 90% classification accuracy.

data.name: Rakshak
data.description: Designed and developed a mobile safety application with real-time features and a user-friendly interface. Built for Android and iOS with a focus on reliability and smooth user experience.
